e5ce0604d6b5b83633510ca0e7da1625ac9b982b.sourceText: 例如，正常坡点被错误估成15 cm高差，且通过其他窗口时，会越过10 cm门槛并可能画成障碍；下坡点若在base_footprint系中低于-0.5 m，又会被min_height删掉。这分别涉及地面估计和投影高度窗口，不能靠同一项参数处理。
e5ce0604d6b5b83633510ca0e7da1625ac9b982b.translatedText: For example, a normal slope point is incorrectly estimated as a 15 cm height difference, and when passing through other windows, it will cross the 10 cm threshold and may be drawn as an obstacle; if a downhill point is below \-0\.5 m in the base_footprint system, it will be deleted by min_height again\. These respectively involve ground estimation and the projection height window, and cannot be handled by the same parameter\.

e5f174edbb13d38d2c0b95f024312ba6a00a3e10.sourceText:
| 处理方式 | 4 m内借入的近场 | 4 m外自身计算 |
|---|---|---|
| 自身点云降采样尺度 | 0.05 m | 0.1 m |
| 写死的地面格子边长 | 0.2 m | 0.4 m |
| 相对估计地面的正常输出范围 | 非负、低于0.5 m | 绝对值、低于1.0 m |
| 低于估计地面的点 | 当前 `considerDrop=False`，被过滤 | 取绝对值，可能进入输出 |
| 最终相对输入高度窗口 | 固定上下界 | 随距离放宽 |
e5f174edbb13d38d2c0b95f024312ba6a00a3e10.translatedText:
| Processing method | Near\-field borrowed within 4 m | Self\-computed beyond 4 m |
|---|---|---|
| Self point cloud downsampling scale | 0\.05 m | 0\.1 m |
| Hard\-coded ground grid cell edge length | 0\.2 m | 0\.4 m |
| Normal output range relative to the estimated ground | Non\-negative, below 0\.5 m | Absolute value, below 1\.0 m |
| Points below the estimated ground | Current `considerDrop=False`, filtered out | Take absolute value, may enter output |
| Final height window relative to input | Fixed upper and lower bounds | Relaxed with distance |
